` L417: ## JavaScript L418: Tabler binds every element with `data-bs-toggle="toast"` to show the toast from its `data-bs-target` on click. This is the code that runs: L419: L420: `onDOMContentLoaded(() => { L421: for (const toastTriggerEl of document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-toggle="toast"], [data-tblr-toggle="toast"]')) { L422: try { L423: // A trigger whose target is missing is left alone instead of getting a L424: // click handler that throws. L425: const toastEl = SelectorEngine.getElementFromSelector(toastTriggerEl) L426: if (!toastEl) { L427: continue L428: } L429: L430: const toast = Toast.getOrCreateInstance(toastEl) as InstanceType L431: toastTriggerEl.addEventListener('click', () => { L432: toast.show() L433: }) L434: } catch (error) { L435: console.error(error) L436: } L437: } L438: })` L439: ## Accessibility L440: * Use `role="status"` with `aria-live="polite"` for most toasts, such as a success message. The reader announces it when it is idle. L441: * Use `role="alert"` with `aria-live="assertive"` only for urgent toasts, such as an error. Assertive interrupts the reader, so keep it for things that matter. L442: * The live region has to be in the DOM before the message arrives. Render an empty toast container on page load and fill it, rather than inserting the whole toast at the moment of the event. L443: * Toasts hide themselves after `data-bs-delay`. That is too fast to read for many people - set `data-bs-autohide="false"` for anything the user has to act on. L444: * A toast does not take focus. Never put the only copy of an action inside one. L445: * Label the close button with `aria-label="Close"`. L446: ## Class reference L447: L448: Every class this component ships, grouped by what it changes. A name in braces stands for a family — `{color}` is any base color, `{breakpoint}` any responsive step. L449: L450: `toast` | component | Container element L451: `toast-container` | part | Positions the toasts on the page L452: `toast-header` | part | Title bar with the close button L453: `toast-body` | part | Message area L454: `toast-{color}` | color | Any base color, for example toast-success or toast-azure L455: L456: ## CSS L457: ### Variables L458: The component uses local CSS variables on `.toast` for real-time customization. Values for the CSS variables are set via Sass, so Sass customization is still supported, too. Source: 【170†`core/scss/bootstrap/_toasts.scss`†github.com】. L609: ## Accessibility L610: * The page title belongs in an `h1`, and there should be exactly one per page. `page-title` is a style, not a heading. L611: * A section title is a real heading. Use an `h2` under the page `h1`, and an `h3` for card titles inside that section. L612: * The pretitle is context, not a heading. Keep it a `div` so it does not break the heading order. L613: * Buttons in `page-header` come after the title in the markup even when they sit to its right. That is the order they should be read in. L614: * An icon-only action needs an `aria-label`. L615: * A search field in the header needs a label. When the design has no room, use `aria-label` and `type="search"`.
